Many pallets have circular stamp marks reading “EPAL” on the deck boards.
Some pallets look light/clean; no obvious broken boards are visible in the provided angles.
No clear pallet dimensions, grade, or count per lot is shown.
No photo shows a scale reading or any weighing process.

claims.evidence: Photos show wooden pallets suitable for stacking/handling.

claims.claim: It available for pickup only in Port Harcourt
claims.evidence: No photo or document shows location; only seller text.

claims.claim: Everything is clean, dry and sorted, no water added.
claims.evidence: Photos show pallets that appear relatively clean, but cannot confirm dryness, sorting completeness, or whether any water was added.

claims.claim: Weighed at 500 kg on a certified scale this morning.
claims.evidence: No scale photo/receipt or weighing video is provided.

risks.risk: Lot weight may not be 500 kg (could be estimated or includes unusable/extra items).
risks.proof: A short video of the certified scale reading with the full lot on it (or a receipt/invoice showing the weight).
risks.if_unproven: Price as a smaller/unknown quantity lot (worst case: treat as not confirmed weight).

risks.risk: Pallet condition/grade may be worse than shown (cracks, missing slats, heavy repairs) which affects resale value.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the worst 5 pallets (corners + underside + any broken boards) and a quick walk-around video.
risks.if_unproven: Price as mixed/used condition (worst case: not guaranteed “clean/dry/sorted”).

risks.risk: EPAL authenticity/standard may vary (some stamps could be worn or non-EPAL pallets mixed).
risks.proof: Photos showing the full stamp/marking on multiple pallets plus any pallet ID/marking details on the stringers.
risks.if_unproven: Price as generic wooden pallets rather than guaranteed EPAL standard.

risks.risk: Count may be unclear; buyers may be charged per kg but need to know how many pallets they get.
risks.proof: A photo showing the total number of pallets (or a labeled grid/count) and/or a video panning across the full stack.
risks.if_unproven: Price as an unknown-count lot (worst case: fewer pallets than expected).

proof_requests: Send a video of the certified scale showing the lot weight (confirming the 500 kg claim).
Send close-ups of the worst-condition pallets (corners, underside, any cracks/missing slats).
Send photos showing EPAL markings/IDs on multiple pallets (not just one or two).
Send a clear shot/video that shows the full lot so the pallet count/extent is verifiable.
response.reason: The item type (wooden pallets with EPAL stamps) is visible, but the key pricing drivers from the seller’s words—especially the confirmed 500 kg weight and the exact lot quantity/condition—are not verifiable from the photos. Without that, a reliable worst-case price pick from the comparables is not possible.
